The '''sea otter''' was a type of [[Otter/Legends|otter]]. The [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnans]],<ref name="OduminDB" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], bore resemblance to the sea otter,<ref name="OduminDB" /> to the point that the species could be regarded as an intelligent subset thereof.<ref name="SWUGSec" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sea otter was first mentioned to describe [[Odumin]] in the reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'', which was written by [[Raymond L. Velasco]] and released in [[1984]].<ref name="SWGuide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> While ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' refers to the Tynnans as sea otters outright,<ref name="SWUGSec" /> the original version<ref name="SWGuide" /> and the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Odumin on [[StarWars.com]] state that the Tynnans merely resemble sea otters.<ref name="OduminDB" /> The out-of-universe article ''[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]'', meanwhile, erroneously describes the Tynnans as [[river otter]]s.<ref name="WWD2000">''[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]''</ref>
